days.title: Departure & Travel to Vietnam
days.summary: Travel from Bangalore to Ho Chi Minh City (overnight flight)

timeline.title: Leave Home
timeline.description: Start early to avoid Bangalore traffic. Travel time ~2.5 hrs.

timeline.title: Reach Airport (BLR)
timeline.description: International Terminal. Keep buffer for check-in & immigration.

timeline.title: Check-in + Immigration
timeline.description: Complete baggage drop, security, and immigration.

timeline.title: Flight Departure
timeline.description: Depart from Bangalore to Ho Chi Minh City (~5 hrs flight).

days.title: Arrival + Recovery Day
days.summary: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City, rest and light exploration

timeline.title: Land in Ho Chi Minh City
timeline.description: Arrive at Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN).
timeline.location: Tan Son Nhat International Airport, Ho Chi Minh City

timeline.title: Immigration & Exit
timeline.description: Complete immigration and collect baggage. Keep passport and hotel address ready.

timeline.title: SIM & Currency Exchange
timeline.description: Buy Viettel SIM (₹300–₹600) and exchange ₹3k–₹5k to VND.
timeline.location: Tan Son Nhat Airport Arrival Hall

timeline.title: Travel to Hotel
timeline.description: Book Grab taxi to District 1 (~30 mins).

timeline.title: Rest & Sleep
timeline.description: Very important recovery sleep after overnight flight.

timeline.title: Lunch
timeline.description: Veg-friendly meal (fried rice/noodles or Indian restaurant).

timeline.title: Light Walk & Café
timeline.description: Explore District 1, relax at a café.

days.title: Mekong Delta Day Trip (Ben Tre)
days.summary: Full-day Mekong Delta tour with boat rides, village experience and return to city
days.city: Ben Tre / Ho Chi Minh City
checklist: Be ready in lobby before pickup

timeline.title: Wake Up & Breakfast
timeline.description: Freshen up and have a light breakfast at hotel.

timeline.title: Pickup from Hotel
timeline.description: Tour van pickup from District 1 hotel.

timeline.title: Travel to Mekong Delta
timeline.description: Drive ~2 hours to Ben Tre. Relax or sleep in van.

timeline.title: Boat Ride Begins
timeline.description: Motorboat ride, coconut candy workshop, village visit.

timeline.title: Village Walk / Cycling
timeline.description: Explore village or short cycling experience.

timeline.title: Relax / Tea Break
timeline.description: Light snacks and rest before return.

timeline.title: Return to Ho Chi Minh City
Rest
timeline.description: Relax and sleep after full day trip.

days.title: Cu Chi Tunnels + Relax + Spa
days.summary: Half-day Cu Chi exploration followed by relaxation and couple spa
checklist: Book Cu Chi half-day tour (hotel pickup)

timeline.title: Wake Up & Breakfast
timeline.description: Freshen up and have breakfast at hotel.

timeline.title: Pickup for Cu Chi Tunnels
timeline.description: Tour van pickup from District 1 hotel.

timeline.title: Explore Cu Chi Tunnels
timeline.description: Walk through tunnels, learn history, see traps. Optional crawl.

timeline.title: Couple Spa
timeline.description: Relaxing spa session (90–120 mins, e.g., Miu Miu Spa).
timeline.location: Miu Miu Spa, Ho Chi Minh City

days.title: Fly to Phu Quoc + Beach Day
days.summary: Travel to Phu Quoc, check-in and relaxed beach day
checklist: Pack small bag (leave main luggage at SGN hotel)
Prepare for possible late check-in (2 PM)

timeline.title: Wake Up & Pack
timeline.description: Freshen up and pack essentials for 2 days.

timeline.title: Hotel Arrival & Luggage Drop
timeline.description: Early check-in may not be available. Leave luggage and use facilities.

timeline.title: Relax / Beach Time
timeline.description: Enjoy beach, pool or rest until room is ready.

timeline.title: Hotel Check-in
timeline.description: Standard check-in time (if not done earlier).

timeline.title: Optional Night Activity
timeline.description: Visit night market or relax at resort.

days.title: Phu Quoc Highlights (Cable Car + Show)
days.summary: Cable car experience, island exploration, evening show and Grand World visit
checklist: Start early for cable car (avoid rush)
Keep tickets ready (book online if possible)

timeline.title: Arrive at Hon Thom Cable Car
Cable Car & Island Exploration
timeline.description: Ride cable car, explore Hon Thom island, beach & photos.

timeline.title: Relax Time
timeline.description: Pool, beach or rest at resort.

timeline.title: Kiss of the Sea Show
timeline.description: Light, water and fire show (~30–45 mins).
timeline.location: Kiss of the Sea, Phu Quoc

timeline.title: Grand World Visit
timeline.description: Explore lights, canals and nightlife area.

timeline.title: Dinner
timeline.description: Dinner at Grand World or nearby.

days.title: Return to SGN + Shopping Day
days.summary: Return from Phu Quoc, luggage drop and shopping in District 1
checklist: Be prepared for late check-in (2 PM)
Leave luggage at hotel before shopping

timeline.title: Wake Up & Pack
timeline.description: Freshen up and pack all items.

timeline.title: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City
Hotel Arrival & Luggage Drop
timeline.description: Leave luggage at reception (check-in later after 2 PM).

timeline.title: Saigon Square Shopping
timeline.description: Shop clothes, shoes, bags and souvenirs.

timeline.title: Continue Shopping
timeline.description: Visit Ben Thanh Market or nearby shops.

days.title: Departure Day
days.summary: Relaxed morning, last-minute exploration and departure from Ho Chi Minh City
checklist: Keep some cash for last expenses

timeline.title: Free Time
timeline.description: Café, short walk or quick shopping.

timeline.title: Luggage Storage & Free Time
timeline.description: Leave luggage at hotel and explore nearby areas.

timeline.title: Relax / Café Time
timeline.description: Keep it light – café, mall or rest.

timeline.title: Return to Hotel
timeline.description: Collect luggage and freshen up if possible.

timeline.title: Reach Airport
timeline.description: Arrive with enough buffer for check-in & immigration.

timeline.title: Flight to India
timeline.description: Departure from Ho Chi Minh City.

flights.notes: Leave home by 5:45 PM to reach airport by ~8:15 PM
Leave hotel by 7:00 AM to reach airport on time
Leave hotel by ~6:00 PM (depends on flight timing)

activities.name: Vietnam E-Visa
activities.notes: Apply at least 5–7 days before travel. Carry printed copy.

activities.name: Travel Insurance
activities.notes: Covers medical + delays. Useful but not mandatory.

activities.name: Forex / Cash (VND)
activities.notes: Exchange small amount at airport, rest in District 1 for better rates.

activities.name: Mekong Delta Day Tour (Ben Tre)
activities.notes: Choose Ben Tre + hotel pickup + veg food request. Start ~7:30 AM.

activities.name: Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour
activities.notes: Prefer morning tour. Wear comfortable clothes. Optional tunnel crawl.

activities.name: Hon Thom Cable Car
activities.notes: Book morning slot. Avoid peak hours. Carry sunscreen.

activities.name: Kiss of the Sea Show
activities.notes: Evening show. Can combine with Grand World visit.

activities.name: Local SIM Card
activities.notes: Buy Viettel SIM at airport after arrival. Needed for Grab & maps.
